_readme: Copy this file to redacted-terms.local.json and fill it in. That name is
gitignored, which is the point: a test that guards your client and project
names out of a public repo must not spell them out inside it. Same pattern
any term appears in a tracked file. With no file present that test skips,
so a fresh clone on someone else's machine checks nothing of yours.
terms: substrings, matched case insensitively. Put the real client name,
project codename, or internal folder name here after you replace it in the
tree, so it cannot come back. One entry per name; a stem like 'Litware'
Use a fictitious stand-in for the replacement, not another real name.
Microsoft cleared Contoso, Fabrikam, Litware, Northwind and Woodgrove for
exactly this, and RFC 2606 reserves example.com / example.org / example.net.
The two entries below are placeholders and appear nowhere in the tree, so
a straight copy of this file passes. Replace them.
